commands.name: Trigger Source
commands.description: Configure or query trigger source, including VIDeo in supported time-domain measurements.
commands.notes: Real hardware verified for the IMMediate and VIDeo source paths used by Instrument Lab. Other source tokens remain outside the verified GUI scope.

commands.name: Video Trigger Level
commands.description: Set or query VIDEO trigger level as 0 to 100 percent of diagram height.
commands.response_notes: VIDEO trigger availability depends on the active measurement/application and is intended for time-domain measurements.
commands.notes: Real hardware verified in the FSW Zero Span VIDEO-trigger workflow. Do not change measurement mode automatically.

commands.name: Trigger Offset
commands.description: Set or query Trigger Offset. Negative values select pre-trigger data.
commands.notes: Real hardware verified as the Trigger Offset used by the VIDEO-trigger workflow. Do not confuse this with IFPower trigger holdoff.

commands.name: Trigger Slope
commands.description: Set or query trigger edge slope for non-time trigger sources.
commands.notes: POSitive/NEGative slope set and readback were verified on the target FSW in the VIDEO-trigger control workflow.
